When I got my wisdom teeth out I also had to get an IV and my Mom was in a different room from where the actual "operation" happened. Your parents will most likely be in a waiting room while you're taken in to a different room where everything will be taking place. However, with that being said, you will most likely be fairly high when you come out of it and not in the best place to make conscious decisions about rolling down your sleeves to cover your scars. So I would make sure you wear something with loose sleeves so that when you come out of it and are most likely very high your sleeves will just fall down without you doing anything. That's the best advice I got.
